TL_candidates.g_cos_note: the LM stalls (reason 2) at least-squares stationary points where J^T r ~ 0 while |r| >> tol; the cosine of a vanishing gradient carries no information there. g_scaled = |g_T - g_or| / (|J_or|_F |r_or|); g_cos_min_nonstationary restricts to candidates with |J^T r| / (|J| |r|) > 1e-2
